description: This file contains test tools for WebTransport resets backend in the quiche QUIC implementation, including class definitions for visitors handling stream resets and session management.

classes.name: ResetsVisitor
classes.description: Handles WebTransport session events, manages logs, and creates stream visitors.

classes.name: BidirectionalEchoVisitorWithLogging
classes.description: A visitor for bidirectional streams that logs reset and stop sending events.

methods.name: OnResetStreamReceived
methods.description: Handles stream reset events, logs the error.

methods.name: OnStopSendingReceived
methods.description: Handles stop sending events, logs the error.

methods.name: WebTransportResetsBackend
methods.description: Creates a WebTransport response with a ResetsVisitor for the session.
